title: The Rail Yard

reward.description: One blast and every train in the yard stops to listen.

hints: Keep self.head pointing at the front Car. An empty train has head = None.
To reach the last car, start at head and follow .next until a car's .next is None.
For detach, keep track of the previous car as you walk, so you can set previous.next = current.next. Removing the head is a special case!
